decks.notes: This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and The Fantasticar to generate card advantage and value. By utilizing powerful artifacts and synergistic interactions, the deck aims to control the game with cards like Force of Will and Chalice of the Void while setting up a winning board state. The inclusion of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Urza's Bauble help to enable the combo and generate further advantage. Overall, the deck aims to create a strong board presence and combo off to secure victory.

The primary focus of this deck is to maintain control of the game through disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, while also utilizing powerful tempo plays with cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Murktide Regent. By combining elements of aggro and tempo, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats quickly and efficiently, ultimately overwhelming the opponent before they can recover. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Daze and Wasteland provide additional ways to disrupt the opponent's mana base, further increasing the deck's ability to control the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing Cloudpost and Tron lands to quickly ramp up mana and cast powerful threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, Eye of the Storms. The deck also includes solid control elements like Force of Will and Force of Negation to disrupt opponents' strategies. The One Ring and Lórien Revealed provide additional ways to generate mana and accelerate the deck's game plan. By efficiently managing resources and utilizing powerful abilities, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its massive mana advantage and high-impact threats.

This deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying consistent pressure through efficient creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing powerful cards like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while also deploying threats like Murktide Regent and Barrowgoyf to close out the game quickly, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and dictate the flow of play. Additionally, cards like Fatal Push and Flow State provide additional removal options to maintain board control.

The main idea of this deck is to maintain tempo and disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of early disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Daze, removal spells like Fatal Push and Snuff Out, and countermagic in the form of Force of Will and Force of Negation. The deck also features efficient threats such as Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf to apply pressure while controlling the board. By leveraging a mix of disruption, card advantage, and aggressive threats, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on using various spells like Dark Ritual, Faithless Looting, and Reanimate to quickly put powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield from the graveyard. It also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Unmask to prevent opponents from stopping the combo. The deck aims to win the game by reanimating powerful creatures early in the game and overwhelming the opponent with threats.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to cast Doomsday and win the game with Thassa's Oracle. The deck utilizes a combination of card draw, disruption, and mana acceleration to efficiently set up the win condition. The Fantasticar is a crucial card in this combo, allowing for additional card draw and filtering to find the necessary pieces. The deck aims to achieve a fast and consistent win through careful planning and execution of its combo strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly playing low-cost spells and creatures to control the tempo of the game. The key strategy is to use cheap spells like Ponder and Brainstorm to set up your plays, while using cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent to apply pressure to your opponent. By efficiently utilizing countermagic like Force of Will and Daze, along with disruptive cards like Wasteland, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while pushing its own aggressive strategy. Overall, the deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent to secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures and then bringing them back into play at a low cost, often bypassing their mana cost entirely. The goal is to cheat powerful threats like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty into play early and overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to react. The deck includes various ways to discard creatures, protect them from removal, and efficiently reanimate them, making it a potent and fast-paced combo deck in the Legacy format.

This deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy by utilizing hand disruption cards like Thoughtseize and countermagic like Force of Will, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares. The deck focuses on tempo plays, using cards like Daze and Wasteland to stay ahead of the opponent. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and filtering, while Flow State and Snuff Out help remove threats. The deck also includes some removal in Fatal Push and Orcish Bowmasters to deal with opposing creatures.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays and maintaining control of the board with disruptive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria. It also utilizes powerful artifacts like Chalice of the Void to slow down opponents, while using cards like Chrome Mox and Lotus Petal for ramp. The deck aims to quickly deploy threats and disrupt opponents' game plans with cards like Anointed Peacekeeper and Clarion Conqueror. The mana base is built to support the aggressive strategy with fast lands like City of Traitors and Ancient Tomb, while also including utility lands like Karakas and Wasteland.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on efficiently deploying creatures and attacking the opponent's life total while disrupting their game plan with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Static Prison. The deck also includes cards like Goblin Bombardment and Guide of Souls to provide additional reach and resilience in the late game. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Voice of Victory and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah enables the deck to apply pressure quickly and close out games before the opponent can stabilize. The mana base is carefully constructed to allow for consistent casting of spells and to support the deck's aggressive strategy.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disrupting their game plan with hand disruption spells like Cabal Therapy and Thoughtseize. The deck also has ways to sacrifice its own creatures for value with cards like Goblin Bombardment. The mana base is designed to support a mix of white, black, and red spells, and includes powerful lands like Wasteland and Karakas. Overall, the deck aims to keep the pressure on the opponent while disrupting their strategy, leading to a fast-paced and versatile gameplay experience.

The main concept of this deck is to use Doomsday to set up a win condition with Thassa's Oracle and a way to protect it with Force of Will. The goal is to quickly assemble the necessary combo pieces using card draw and mana acceleration like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal. The Fantasticar can help with card selection and fetching key cards. The deck also includes disruption with Thoughtseize and Daze to prevent the opponent from interfering with the combo. The mana base is designed to support the combo and includes some fetch lands for consistency.

The main focus of this deck is to efficiently control the game through a combination of land interaction and powerful control elements. By utilizing cards like Thespian's Stage, Crop Rotation, and Exploration, the deck aims to establish a strong land base while disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Wasteland and Pithing Needle. The inclusion of cards like Dark Depths and Malevolent Rumble offer win conditions that can quickly end the game if left unchecked. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around controlling the game tempo and disrupting the opponent's game plan through land manipulation and control elements.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining pressure and tempo through the use of efficient threats and disruptive spells. The deck utilizes cards like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will to control the opponent's plays, while deploying creatures like Nethergoyf and Murktide Regent to close out the game quickly. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and utility, while cards like Fatal Push and Snuff Out help deal with opposing threats. The mana base is optimized for consistency and allows for the deck to function smoothly.
